title: Storage Space & Analyzer
summary: Free Up Storage Space with File Manager & Memory Cleaner.
description:
Running out of phone storage space?
Want to clean junk files and manage your internal & external memory easily?

Storage Cleaner & File Manager helps you free up storage space, clean large files, manage SD card storage, and organize your files with powerful yet easy-to-use tools.

Get a complete overview of your device storage and quickly find what is taking up space on your phone.

🚀 Key Features

📊 Used Memory Details

Check complete storage information for your device.

✔ View used and available storage space
✔ Analyze internal & external memory usage
✔ See installed apps with app size
✔ View system apps storage usage
✔ Find videos with total storage size
✔ Find images with total storage size
✔ View audio files and music storage
✔ Analyze documents and downloads
✔ View other files using device storage
✔ Delete multiple unused files easily

⚡ Memory Optimizer

Quickly find large files that consume storage.

✔ Detect large videos, images, audio, and documents
✔ Filter files by custom size
✔ Clean unnecessary big files in one tap
✔ Works on internal storage and SD card

📁 Smart File Manager

Manage your files faster and more efficiently.

✔ Browse files by category
✔ Move, copy, rename, and delete files
✔ Open and share files instantly
✔ Easy file organization tools
✔ Full support for SD card & external storage

🧹 Duplicate Files Cleaner

Recover extra storage space by removing duplicate files.

✔ Find duplicate photos, videos, audio, and documents
✔ Smart duplicate file scanning
✔ Delete duplicate files safely
✔ Improve storage performance

🌟 Why Choose This App?

✔ Free up phone storage space
✔ Clean junk and unwanted files
✔ Organize files easily
✔ Manage internal & external memory
✔ Fast, lightweight, and easy to use
✔ Simple and user-friendly interface

Download Storage Cleaner & File Manager today and keep your device clean, organized, and optimized.
